title: Reset failure
summary: A failed reset receipt names its failure: a check row's name and ok come from the operation, never nested evidence. When the server refuses a receipt, test_machine_operation_submit_failed repeats the host's error code, reason and recovery. A failed macOS reset keeps its first error code, and failed_calls records each failed call's exit code and bounded stderr, or its exception type and message; the runner's own SSH failure (exit 124) is test_mac_reset_transport_failed. Reset first finds each identity browser main process with /bin/ps -U USER and awk (argv holds --user-data-dir=$HOME/.yoke-browser-identities/ and no --type=), sends it SIGTERM, Chromium's clean shutdown that flushes cookies, and waits up to 30 seconds; it never force-kills. Sign-in refusals stop before anything is cleared: test_machine_sign_in_app_quit_not_proved when an identity browser is still running (close its windows at the console, then retry; never force-quit), and test_machine_sign_in_app_probe_failed when the process probe fails (check SSH, then retry). The Terminal refusals also stop before clearing: test_machine_terminal_quit_not_proved when Terminal survives its quit and a forced kill of its window processes, and test_machine_terminal_probe_failed when pgrep fails. System Events is stopped alongside Terminal before clearing the home: test_machine_system_events_probe_failed means its process state could not be read; test_machine_system_events_quit_not_proved means it survived graceful quit and forced tree termination. Repair SSH/process access for an unreadable probe, or quit System Events in Activity Monitor at the host console, then retry reset. After a successful restore the reset relaunches Terminal without saved windows; test_machine_terminal_relaunch_failed means no window appeared. A harness probe whose reply the parser rejected keeps a sanitized reply_rejection record (rejection branch, event types, final event shape, exact-OK/tool-use/degraded-context booleans, harness exit code; never reply text) on its failed row; a QA run stores it as a probe_reply_rejection artifact and names the branch in its verdict reason. A golden sealed before these records returns none and its reason asks for a recapture. A Linux golden archive command that exits nonzero, including a timeout, keeps transport_diagnostics in its receipt with private SSH client debug and sshd journal log paths, the operation window and journal collection status. Collection uses the existing SSH transport and a bounded noninteractive journal read. A command that exits 0 removes its log folder, skips the journal read and records only status command_succeeded with the operation window. Inspect these logs before attributing SSH exit 255; an unavailable journal or warning alone does not prove a cause. Command payloads and capability secrets are redacted from retained logs. macOS reset emits success counters only after final process validation. A final-gate failure begins with the existing reap_processes phase marker and retains surviving reap failures and matching processes in process_state. Host load is not a reset condition. This source correction does not diagnose historical failures, recover lost stdout or goldens, or prove a live host repair.
